proposed_capability: P95: POST_CLICK_VERIFY_ESCAPE_CANCEL — after every intentional chrome click, immediately score intended ui_chrome target vs observed client pixels (HIT/NEAR_MISS/MISS, ABOVE_TARGET/BELOW_TARGET, LOT_PUNCH_THROUGH_RISK). On non-HIT, halt further mutating recipe steps and recover with Escape (ui_chrome CANCEL_HOLD) instead of placing/buying into the lot. Remeasure catalog.search_field 1920x1080 Y that agents undershoot into the lot. P124: peer click_error_eval beside ui_chrome / screen_atlas / behavior_input_catalog — evaluate + recovery plan only; reuse CANCEL_HOLD; no auto-reclick loop; no second SendInput daemon.
player_save_control_impact: Evaluate-only scoring plus Escape-cancel recovery *plans*. No SendInput from this module, no lot mutation, no save edits. Live Escape dispatch remains a separate host admission. Forbids treating lot placement as success after a missed catalog click.
expected_outcome: contracts/click-error-eval.v1.json + betterinstincts/click_error_eval.py + scripts/click_error_eval.py + tests; decide_post_click → ESCAPE_CANCEL via CANCEL_HOLD on NEAR_MISS/MISS; ui_chrome CLICK_TARGET steps carry VERIFY_THEN_ESCAPE_ON_MISS; remapped search_field client ≈(140,864) ny=0.8000; docs/LEDGER + UI_CHROME + PROMPT_INVOCATIONS pointers.
